sloka: अपि कौशिक भद्रम् ते गुरुणा मम संगता ।माता मम मुनिश्रेष्ठ राम संदर्शनात् इतः ॥१-५१-७॥
transliteration: api kauśika bhadram te guruṇā mama saṁgatā ।mātā mama muniśreṣṭha rāma saṁdarśanāt itaḥ ॥1-51-7॥

translations.english: O Son of Kushika (Viswamitra) be blessed. O the best among the ascetics, as a result of beholding Rama, was my mother united with my father?
